messages:
sara (support): @kevin urgent - ACME reports tool results getting attached to the wrong call when they issue parallel tool calls in one request. customer sees names mixed between user_lookup and generate_bio. :rotating_light:

kevin (eng-runtime): can you paste the raw request and one or two affected responses?

sara (support): customer pasted this payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/run_tools
{
  "request_id": "rc_7f3",
  "tools": [
    {"name":"user_lookup", "args": {"id": 123}},
    {"name":"generate_bio", "args": {"name": "{{user.name}}"}}
  ]
}
```

sara (support): they call both in parallel (client does Promise.all). intermittently generate_bio receives empty name or wrong name from a different user.

james (ml-infra): pulled matching logs from prod for that request_id. suspicious collision in result ids: 
```
[2026-03-16T18:12:01.123Z] req=rc_7f3 tool=user_lookup call_id=call_42 result_id=rid_9 status=200
[2026-03-16T18:12:01.124Z] req=rc_7f3 tool=generate_bio call_id=call_43 result_id=rid_9 status=200
```
james (ml-infra): both tool results emitted the same result_id (rid_9) which is used by the control plane to resolve placeholders. that explains the cross-association.

kevin (eng-runtime): hypothesis: result_id generation used a non-unique runtime-local counter combined w/weak entropy. under high concurrency two in-flight tool completions can observe the same counter value before it's persisted.

olivia (oncall): repro steps ACME provided:
1) spawn 50 concurrent requests that each fan out tools [user_lookup, generate_bio]
2) inject latency on user_lookup (200-800ms) to create overlap
3) observe ~3-5% mismatched name->bio associations after 10k requests

kevin (eng-runtime): short-term mitigation: enable strict UUIDs for tool_result ids (TOOL_RESULT_STRICT=true) which forces crypto UUIDs instead of the fast counter. I'll schedule a 5% canary.

sara (support): customer is on Dedicated with SLA; they want an urgent patch. can we expedite?

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout of runtime/v12 to pool-us-east-1 (5%) at 2026-03-17T02:34:05Z (deploy id: 1923456805)

kevin (eng-runtime): long-term fix: 
- attach immutable request_id to every tool_result mapping entry in the control plane
- make per-request mapping table keyed by (request_id, call_id) instead of global result_id registry
- add unit + integration tests for heavy fanout race scenarios
- add runtime invariant check: never reuse result_id within a single process without confirmation from control-plane ack

james (ml-infra): I'll write a repro harness that floods a single runtime with parallel calls and validates mapping. sharing node snippet used by customer:
```js
const calls = tools.map(t => fetch('/v1/tool', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(t)}));
await Promise.all(calls);
```

olivia (oncall): after canary rolled to the customer's pool they reported reduction to 0 mismatches in their verification run. :thumbsup:

sara (support): marking as escalated->fixed provisional. will open a follow-up postmortem and add rollout checklist. tagging eng-runtime and ml-infra for follow-ups. thanks all for quick response.

kevin (eng-runtime): assigning follow-ups:
- KEV-211: make result_id generation UUID-by-default (in review)
- KEV-212: control-plane mapping change (planning)
- JAMS-98: repro harness + tests

sara (support): customer asked for timeline and root cause write-up; i'll draft summary once KEV-212 has spec.

james (ml-infra): note for postmortem: also check how fallback paths (schema validation failures) interact with result registry; we saw one case where a schema-validated fallback retried and reused the previous result_id. we'll include that in RCA.

olivia (oncall): leaving assigned until KEV-211 merged.

sara (support): closing thread here, moving to postmortem doc.
